chat.answers.What does VP NEXUES do?: We supply high-quality agricultural and food products for domestic and international markets. Farm-to-table organic produce connecting Tamil Nadu’s finest farmers with global tables.
chat.answers.about vpnexues: Est. 2022 — Tamil Nadu’s Premier Organic Farm-to-Table Export Company. Connecting farmers directly with consumers. No middlemen, fair pricing, guaranteed freshness. Ships to India, Singapore, USA & UAE.
chat.answers.Why should I choose VPNexues?:
Quality: 100% certified organic, lab-tested produce.
Reliability: Consistent supply with on-time delivery.
Traceability: QR codes on every carton.
Fair Trade: Direct from farmers, no middlemen.
chat.answers.source from farmers: We source directly from certified organic farms across Tamil Nadu. Every farm is audited and certified under Indian & international organic standards.
chat.answers.product quality: All products are 100% certified organic. Soil, water & produce tested at independent labs. QR code on every carton shows farm, harvest date & inspection report.
chat.answers.What products do you sell?:
Vegetables: Tomato, Carrot, Eggplant, Lady Finger, Broccoli, Beans, Onion
Fruits: Mango, Banana, Apple, Watermelon
Grains & Spices: Coffee Beans, Dal, Rice, Premium Spices
Other: Fresh Eggs, Beverages, Groceries
All chemical-free, sourced from certified organic farms.
chat.answers.do you provide organic products: Yes! All our products are 100% certified organic. We work directly with certified organic farms across Tamil Nadu.
chat.answers.freshness: Harvested to order, packed within hours. Cold-chain insulated packaging with ice packs. Temperature-controlled freight for international shipments.
chat.answers.shelf life:
Leafy Vegetables: 3–5 days (refrigerated)
Root Vegetables & Fruits: 7–10 days
Spices & Grains: Up to 12 months. Every pack lists harvest date & best-before guidance.
chat.answers.product samples: Yes, product samples are available depending on the product and request. Contact us to request samples for your evaluation.
chat.answers.pricing plans:
Small Box — ₹1,550: Min 10 products. Mix veg, fruits & groceries.
Big Box — ₹5,518: Min 10 kg. Any mix. 12% discount.
B2B Custom — Quote: Restaurants, hotels. 30-day credit.
chat.answers.small box: Small Box — ₹1,550: Min 10 products per box. Mix vegetables, fruits & groceries. Weekly or fortnightly delivery. Items after 10 charged at +15% premium.
chat.answers.big box: Big Box — ₹5,518: Min 10 kg total weight. Any mix from any category. No item count limit. 12% bulk discount auto-applied at 10 kg+.
chat.answers.minimum order:
Retail: No minimum — order a single item if you need.
B2B / Wholesale: Minimum varies by product. Contact our B2B team for a quote.
chat.answers.gift: Curated Small Box & Big Box subscriptions. Festive hampers during Diwali, Pongal & year-end. Subscribers get up to 15% off + priority delivery.
chat.answers.how to place an order:
1. Browse at vpnexues.com/shop
2. Add items to your cart
3. Choose box type: Small Box, Big Box, or B2B
4. Enter delivery details & complete payment. No account needed — checkout as a guest!
chat.answers.track my order:
1. My Account → "My Orders"
2. Tracking link via WhatsApp/email
3. Order ID starts with VPN- (e.g. VPN-24581). Need help? Call +91 9943994603
chat.answers.cancel order: You can modify or cancel within 4 hours of placement (before packing). Contact via WhatsApp (+91 9943994603) or Email (support@vpnexues.com). Include your order ID.
chat.answers.modify order: You can modify within 4 hours of placement (before packing). Contact via WhatsApp (+91 9943994603) or Email (support@vpnexues.com). Include your order ID.
chat.answers.promo code:
1. Go to checkout
2. Find "Apply Coupon" field
3. Enter code and click "Apply"
4. Discount reflected in order total.
chat.answers.delivery info: We deliver across Singapore, India, UAE, USA & Europe. Free delivery on subscription plans. Same-day delivery in select cities.
chat.answers.shipping charges:
Tamil Nadu: FREE on orders above ₹999
Rest of India: Calculated at checkout by weight
International: Quoted at checkout. No hidden fees.
chat.answers.where do you deliver: We ship to: India, Singapore, United States, United Arab Emirates. New destinations reviewed quarterly.
chat.answers.delayed order:
1. Check tracking link for updated ETA
2. If 2+ days past promised date, WhatsApp +91 9943994603 with order ID. We’ll escalate it immediately.
chat.answers.no one home: Delivery attempted up to 2 times. Package held at nearest hub for 3 days. Leave a note at checkout like "Leave with security" or "Call before delivery".
chat.answers.payment methods:
Cards: Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex
UPI: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM
Net Banking: All major Indian banks
Other: PayNow (SG), PayPal, Bank Transfer (B2B)
chat.answers.cod: Available for select Tamil Nadu pin codes. Orders under ₹5,000. Not available for international or B2B orders.
chat.answers.payment failed: Usually auto-refunded by bank within 5–7 business days. If not refunded after 7 days, email support@vpnexues.com with transaction ID.
chat.answers.gst invoice: Auto-sent to registered email after payment. For business GSTIN, provide at checkout or email before dispatch.
chat.answers.return policy: We don’t accept returns on opened items. If a product arrives damaged, expired, or wrong: free replacement, full refund (5–7 days), or store credit with 5% bonus. Report within 24 hours.
chat.answers.refund: Full refund to original payment (5–7 business days). Free replacement on next delivery. Store credit with 5% bonus. Contact within 24 hours with order ID + photo.
chat.answers.damaged product: Contact us within 24 hours with: order ID, photo of damaged product, and a short note. We’ll arrange free replacement or full refund.
chat.answers.wrong product: Contact us within 24 hours with: order ID, photo of wrong product, and a short note. We’ll arrange free replacement or full refund.
chat.answers.b2b orders:
We Supply: Restaurants, Hotels, Grocery Chains, Food Processing, Institutions
What You Get: Custom categories, Account manager, Invoice billing, 30-day credit, Organic & Halal certs.
chat.answers.become a distributor: Interested in becoming a distributor? Contact our B2B team at support@vpnexues.com or call +91 9943994603.
chat.answers.customized packaging: Yes, we provide customised packaging for bulk orders. Discuss your requirements with our B2B team.
chat.answers.request a quotation: Send us your requirements and we will provide a customised quotation. Response time: Usually within 24 business hours.
chat.answers.do you export: Yes, we export products to international markets including Singapore, USA, and UAE. Contact our B2B team at support@vpnexues.com for export enquiries.

chat.sugg.ecoPackaging: All deliveries use 100% recyclable, plastic-free packaging — paper wraps and compostable trays only.

chat.sugg.upiApps: UPI is supported! Pay via Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm and all major UPI apps with instant confirmation.

chat.sugg.secureEncrypted: Every transaction is protected with TLS encryption and tokenized card storage — we never store your card details.
chat.sugg.freshReturns24h: Report it within 24 hours of delivery with a photo — we will replace or refund it free of charge.
chat.sugg.refund3to5: Once approved, refunds reach your original payment method within 3–5 business days.
chat.sugg.damagedPhotoSupport: Send a photo to WhatsApp +91 9943994603 or email support@vpnexues.com with your order ID — we will fix it within 24 hours.
